instruction: Collect all text from the slides in the presentation file and compile them into a Word document called "transcript.docx" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting all text from PowerPoint slides to Word document. Evaluator now verifies: (1) title is in first line, (2) key phrases from multiple slides are present in the full document, (3) minimum paragraph count to ensure completeness. This comprehensive approach validates that all slide content was extracted, not just the title.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts ALL text content from DOCX file (all_text, paragraphs, paragraph_count, first_line)
Metric verifies multiple aspects: (1) title in first line (30%), (2) key phrases across entire document (50%), (3) minimum paragraph count (20%)
Coverage is complete: checks title placement, content from multiple slides (via key phrases), and content completeness (via paragraph count)
Logical flow is correct: getter extracts full document → metric checks key phrases in all_text (not just first line) → weighted scoring
Postconfig properly saves file before verification
Minor limitation: key phrases are somewhat generic, but combined with min_paragraphs=5 check, provides reasonable assurance of completeness
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding more specific key phrases from later slides to strengthen verification of complete extraction
Could add check for text from the last slide to ensure all slides were processed in order
